scope: Image technical quality, aesthetic quality, and generated/edited origin

queries.query: Official research datasets for image quality assessment published 2025 2026 with human technical quality scores authentic photographs and individual distortion attributes dataset download
queries.objective: Find primary author project repositories and publications with new human-rated IQA datasets not simply KonIQ SPAQ FLIVE or KADID. Extract names counts labels and releases.

queries.query: Official image aesthetics assessment dataset human aesthetic ratings 2025 2026 diverse photographs composition lighting attributes aesthetic evaluation dataset
queries.objective: Find new aesthetics datasets and verified author pages beyond AVA AADB PARA TAD66K. Prefer releases with human attributes and commercial-compatible terms; report concrete counts.

queries.query: Official benchmark dataset AI generated AI edited real images detection 2025 2026 semantic matched realistic recent generators FLUX GPT image dataset release
queries.objective: Find primary author repositories of new origin detection datasets beyond GenImage Synthbuster SynthCLIC Community Forensics. Look for partially AI edited images and generator-disjoint robust evaluation.

queries.query: MMP-2k ViDA-UGC official dataset github download license human quality scores source images
queries.objective: Locate original GitHub and release metadata for MMP-2k and ViDA-UGC; extract actual licenses, download locations and source overlap.

queries.query: BBC PAIR OpenSDID RealHD official dataset access download licensing research image manipulation benchmark
queries.objective: Find primary dataset cards and repositories for matched local editing detection datasets, with source photo terms and access requirements.

queries.query: REPID DEAR image rendering quality dataset human preference 30000 100 subset official Hugging Face license
queries.objective: Determine whether REPID is renamed DEAR, actual publicly released size, label protocol and license; use author paper/card.

queries.query: Fine grained aesthetic image datasets released FGAesthetics dataset 32217 series 2026 AesCanvas human labels Github benchmark
queries.objective: Find newly accessible official datasets for same-scene fine-grained aesthetic judgments and whether labels are human or synthetic. Check FGAesthetics actual data release.

queries.query: RealHD dataset real-hd github license 730000 2025 download official
queries.objective: Verify author dataset repo count and dataset-specific license including source images and inpainting masks.

queries.query: RRDataset Real World Robustness Dataset 14963880 Zenodo license 2025 images 3000 download
queries.objective: Verify original Zenodo release count, transmission recapture design, file sizes and reuse license.

queries.query: OpenFake dataset 2025 2026 official github partial edited images commercial license 43 generators FLUX GPT
queries.objective: Find official OpenFake data card, count and partial-edit metadata as a potentially practical alternative to institution-restricted BBC PAIR.

queries.query: OpenFake v2 dataset corrections repaired duplicate prompt image mismatch September October 2026 held out test source leakage
queries.objective: Find the dataset authors' current correction/audit notes. Verify whether label or prompt mismatch issues remain, exact current split counts, license and real-source matching.

queries.query: OpenSDI OpenSDID dataset license Megalith train test masks partial real image overlap source copyright academic
queries.objective: Read primary card, repo and paper for inherited image rights, train-test or source overlap, manipulation mask fields, exact partial and full counts; avoid mirrors as license evidence.

queries.query: FGAesthetics annotation human annotators pairwise Gemini Rank Calibration release dataset source labels
queries.objective: Verify whether ranks are human judgments or synthetic Gemini labels and inherited source overlap; inspect primary paper and supplement.

queries.query: MMP-2k image quality report ChatGPT human annotation 17 raters license source study 512 1024 macro distortion
queries.objective: Verify human MOS versus model-written report distinction, rated resolution, and important intentional depth-of-field failure mode using primary paper.

queries.query: SIDA Social Media Image Deepfake Detection Localization Explanation SID Set 300000 240000 OpenImages generated tampered official dataset license
queries.objective: Cross-check HF agent candidate saberzl/SID_Set against primary SIDA paper/repository; verify counts 210k train 30k validation 60k held-out test, actual image origin labels/masks, source rights, and overlap risk.

rounds.purpose: Final primary validation of known, unacquired priority candidates
findings: MSC: 10,426 images, 100 human aesthetic ratings each, low-semantic natural scenes, variants; retain per-image image terms.
CID2013: 474 unique images, 480 evaluations, 79 devices, MOS and raw attributes; retain detailed copyright notice and scene groups.
